text: Lebanon's Health Ministry counts 4,386 dead since 2 March, with no civilian/combatant split. Israel's estimate of Hezbollah dead is 1,700–2,500. Hezbollah publishes no totals; sources cite 1,000+. How many of the dead were fighters remains unresolved.

judge.comment: Both sides are attributed and neither is adjudicated. Contested-type posts require human review, and the IDF/independent estimate carries no precise as-of date.

factChecks.claim: 4,386 killed in Lebanon since 2 March, no civilian/combatant split (Lebanese Ministry of Public Health)
Hezbollah publishes no totals; Hezbollah sources cite 1,000+
